title: What if Earth suddenly stopped spinning? 🌍
subject: earth
description:
Which version would you rather live through? 👇

What would happen if the Earth stopped rotating? A sudden stop would be catastrophic, but a slow one would turn a single day into a whole year and drain the oceans toward the poles.

Sources: Space.com (Andrew Layden, Bowling Green State University), Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum (How Things Fly), Esri ArcUser (Witold Fraczek)

scenes.text: If Earth stopped spinning suddenly, you'd fly at 1,000 mph.
That's the equator's speed. The air and oceans would keep going too, scraping the land clean.
Earthquakes and tsunamis would hit almost everywhere except the poles.
But here's the strange part. If it slowed gently instead, one day would last a year: 6 months of light, 6 months of dark.
The oceans would slide toward the poles, and a giant continent would rise around the equator.
